primarySource.paraphrase: The National Institute of Korean Language describes -는 바람에 as cause/reason and generally used where the earlier event has a negative effect. This supports a usual-use note, not a universal ban on positive results.

current.explanation_de: Drückt eine vorsichtige Bitte aus, indem die gewünschte Handlung als hilfreiche Möglichkeit formuliert wird.

current.note: Höflicher und weniger direkt als eine Verpflichtung; passt zu Kolleginnen, Kollegen oder Dienstleistenden.
current.explanation_en: Expresses a gentle request by presenting the desired action as something that would be helpful.
current.example_en: If the schedule changes, I would appreciate it if you could let me know as soon as possible.
current.note_en: It is more polite and less direct than an obligation and suits coworkers or service staff.
